en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of subject is to make an elaborating of selected detailed analytic and synthetic thematic geoecological maps of large scale as a basis for proposals of kinds of landscape management. This is a 5-day field course, which usually takes place in May in Hostětín.
